tools.name: calculate_trip_cost
tools.description: Sum full-party quotes in one currency for flights, stays, transfers, seats and bags. Unpriced components stay unknown.

tools.name: check_price_watch
tools.description: Check a saved flight search now and report whether the indicative group price meets the target.

tools.name: compare_airports
tools.description: Compare up to nine airport-pair alternatives for a one-way or round trip.

locale.description: BCP 47 locale. If omitted, use the language of the requested market.

tools.name: compare_checkout_quotes
tools.description: Compare seller totals observed before payment for identical flights, party, fare conditions and extras. Excludes listings and mismatches, and shows changes from the original quote.

tools.name: compare_fare_totals
tools.description: Rank fares with quoted bags and seats per passenger and leg. Unknown prices remain unknown, and estimates are clearly marked.

tools.name: compare_travel_parties
tools.description: Find flights for groups travelling from different cities and report the sum of separate bookings when comparable.

locale.description: BCP 47 locale. If omitted, use the language of the requested market.

tools.name: compare_weekends
tools.description: Compare consecutive date pairs, exclude calendar conflicts and apply separate time windows on each leg. Maximum thirteen weeks.

locale.description: BCP 47 locale. If omitted, use the language of the requested market.

tools.name: delete_price_watch
tools.description: Remove one locally saved price watch.

tools.name: explore_dates
tools.description: Explore indicative prices near an outbound date. Search the exact party and dates before relying on the amount.

tools.name: explore_destinations
tools.description: Discover destinations from one airport for a selected departure date.

tools.name: export_itinerary_calendar
tools.description: Return an ICS calendar file as text. Prefer timestamps with explicit UTC offsets.

tools.name: find_flight_hotel_packages
tools.description: Find real flight and hotel packages from Lastminute for the specified travel party.

tools.name: find_rental_cars
tools.description: Search car rentals from the airport or city for exact local pickup and drop-off times.

tools.name: find_stays
tools.description: Search hotel quotes for a verified city. Use the Italian city name, e.g. Lione, with its country code. Verify occupancy and taxes at checkout.

tools.name: get_avinor_flight_status
tools.description: Look up an arrival or departure at an Avinor airport in Norway. Share the returned attribution link next to the data. A missing row is not a cancellation.

tools.name: get_bologna_flight_status
tools.description: Read the official Bologna airport page for an arrival or departure today or tomorrow, verifying flight number and local date.

tools.name: get_faa_airport_conditions
tools.description: Read FAA airport advisories for a US airport, including published ground delays, stops or closure restrictions. Read the restriction scope and verify individual flights with the airline.

tools.name: get_fiumicino_departure_status
tools.description: Read the official Rome Fiumicino departures board and verify the flight date before returning a gate, terminal, check-in desk and status. A missing row is not a cancellation.

tools.name: get_flight_assistance
tools.description: Find official airline and airport links for check-in, gate and disruption updates, baggage and passenger support.

tools.name: get_italian_aviation_strikes
tools.description: Read upcoming Italian aviation strike announcements published by the Ministry of Transport for inclusive dates. Reports the published scope and hours. Check actual flight operation with the airline.

tools.name: get_kaohsiung_flight_board
tools.description: Find a flight number on today's Kaohsiung airport snapshot. Source rows lack individual dates. Include dataset attribution when presenting results.

tools.name: get_songshan_flight_status
tools.description: Read today's Taipei Songshan arrival or departure boards in Taipei local time. Times reported by the board can be estimates. Share the dataset attribution and license with results.

tools.name: get_stay_checkout_link
tools.description: Generate the external checkout link for a selected Lastminute room or package rate.

tools.name: import_calendar_conflicts
tools.description: Extract blocked travel dates from supplied iCalendar text. Recurring or named-time-zone events are reported as ignored.

tools.name: inspect_axel_fare
tools.description: Read an Axel nonstop offer. Show quoted baggage fees with their original unit and fare-specific seat-selection conditions. No per-seat quote is provided.

tools.name: inspect_stay_or_package
tools.description: Find room options and current quote details using IDs from Lastminute hotel or package results.

tools.name: list_price_watches
tools.description: Read saved flight searches and price targets.

tools.name: list_providers
tools.description: List free public sources and any explicitly configured Skyscanner partner source.

tools.name: quote_airtreks_itinerary
tools.description: Get a live AirTreks group quote for explicit dated legs on one fare. Supports open jaws. Published flight descriptions omit exact times, and the seller planner is a generic link.

tools.name: quote_flights_with_baggage
tools.description: Get Kiwi API flight quotes with cabin and hold bags requested per traveller. The price and bag specifications can differ on the seller page. Check them before paying.

locale.description: BCP 47 locale. If omitted, use the language of the requested market.

tools.name: refresh_offer
tools.description: Check a prior offer by repeating the exact search with the original provider and passenger composition. If the offer ID is absent, its prior price is unverified.

locale.description: BCP 47 locale. If omitted, use the language of the requested market.

tools.name: resolve_airport
tools.description: Resolve a place name or existing airport code via Skiplagged.

tools.name: save_price_watch
tools.description: Save a local fare target for a specific party and itinerary. Check it on demand.

locale.description: BCP 47 locale. If omitted, use the language of the requested market.

tools.name: search_awards
tools.description: Find candidate award seats. Recheck miles, taxes and availability with the loyalty program.

tools.name: search_flights
tools.description: Search by explicit flight legs, exact party, market, and local time windows. The optional partner source must be selected explicitly.

locale.description: BCP 47 locale. If omitted, use the language of the requested market.

tools.name: search_split_itinerary
tools.description: Compare successive one-way fares for a multi-city or open-jaw itinerary with independently purchased tickets. Do not infer protected connections.

locale.description: BCP 47 locale. If omitted, use the language of the requested market.

tools.name: track_airborne_flight
tools.description: Look up a commercial ICAO callsign using public ADS-B. Use the airline board for cancellation, delay, terminal and gate.
